content.content:
# Fax Processing - Quality and Release

**Confidence is not accuracy.** These telemetry views show workflow/model signals, not independently adjudicated correctness. Production release requires the success-criteria sample sizes and audit evidence. The current synthetic held-out exact-field result is 12/18 and is not approved for clinical automatic release.

content.query:
let Latest = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith "FAX_METRIC "
| extend Fact=parse_json(substring(Message, 11))
| extend FaxId=tostring(Fact.faxId), Status=tostring(Fact.status), DocumentType=tostring(Fact.documentType), Mode=tostring(Fact.completionMode), Source=tostring(Fact.sourceLabel)
| where isnotempty(FaxId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FaxId;
Latest
| summarize Faxes=count() by DocumentType, Status, Mode, Source
| order by Faxes desc

AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith "FAX_METRIC "
| extend Fact=parse_json(substring(Message, 11))
| extend FaxId=tostring(Fact.faxId), Status=tostring(Fact.status), Reason=tostring(Fact.reason), Source=tostring(Fact.sourceLabel), DocumentType=tostring(Fact.documentType)
| where Status in ("PendingHumanReview", "Failed") and isnotempty(FaxId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FaxId
| summarize Faxes=count() by Reason, DocumentType, Source
| order by Faxes desc

AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith "FAX_METRIC "
| extend Fact=parse_json(substring(Message, 11))
| extend FaxId=tostring(Fact.faxId), MinimumConfidence=todouble(Fact.fieldMinimumConfidence), DocumentType=tostring(Fact.documentType), Source=tostring(Fact.sourceLabel)
| where isnotempty(FaxId) and isnotnull(MinimumConfidence)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FaxId
| extend Band=case(MinimumConfidence < 0.8, "< 0.80", MinimumConfidence < 0.9, "0.80-0.89", MinimumConfidence < 0.95, "0.90-0.94", "0.95-1.00")
| summarize Faxes=count() by Band, DocumentType, Source
| order by Band asc

AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith "FAX_METRIC "
| extend Fact=parse_json(substring(Message, 11))
| extend FaxId=tostring(Fact.faxId), Hl7Disposition=tostring(Fact.hl7Disposition), Profile=tostring(Fact.hl7Profile), DocumentType=tostring(Fact.documentType), Mode=tostring(Fact.completionMode)
| where isnotempty(FaxId) and isnotempty(Hl7Disposition)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FaxId
| summarize Faxes=count() by Hl7Disposition, Profile, DocumentType, Mode
| order by Faxes desc

AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith "FAX_METRIC "
| extend Fact=parse_json(substring(Message, 11))
| extend FaxId=tostring(Fact.faxId), ConfigSha256=tostring(Fact.configSha256), PageClassifier=tostring(Fact.modelIds.pageClassifier), FaxTypeClassifier=tostring(Fact.modelIds.faxTypeClassifier), Extractor=tostring(Fact.modelIds.extractor), CalibrationId=tostring(Fact.calibrationId)
| where isnotempty(FaxId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FaxId
| summarize Faxes=count() by ConfigSha256, PageClassifier, FaxTypeClassifier, Extractor, CalibrationId
| order by Faxes desc

content.content:
## Required external evidence

Audited all-fields-correct rate, critical clinical errors, cover precision/recall, type confusion matrices, cost per fax, and receiver acceptance cannot be inferred from Application Insights. Join independently adjudicated audit, billing, and receiver evidence in a governed reporting store before adding those tiles. Zero telemetry rows means **unknown**, not zero errors.
